summary: Resolve Home Manager's macOS launchd agents for service lookup and worker authority

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay changes.

rules.detail: Worker authority rules are unchanged. On a default-instance Mac where Home Manager runs the legacy-phase agents, the supervisor observation now finds the running worker, so its generation is pinned. Before this change every worker request ran the failing lookup again.

compatibility.detail: Default-instance macOS service lookup recognizes org.nix-community.home.smalltalk and org.nix-community.home.smalltalk-replication alongside the CLI labels, as Linux already does for smalltalk.service. `fractal service status`, start, stop, restart and uninstall now act on Home Manager's agents when those are the installed ones. Smalltalk agents remain in the legacy family, and conflicting legacy and Fractal installations are still refused. Named instances are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Takes effect on the next daemon restart.

recovery.detail: Binary swap-back requires no data migration.
